يعق (form I)
# يَعُقُّ (yaʕuqqu) /ja.ʕuq.qu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of عَقَّ (ʕaqqa)
# يُعَقُّ (yuʕaqqu) /ju.ʕaq.qu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of عَقَّ (ʕaqqa)
# يَعُقَّ (yaʕuqqa) /ja.ʕuq.qa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of عَقَّ (ʕaqqa)
# يُعَقَّ (yuʕaqqa) /ju.ʕaq.qa/: third-person masc
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
